events.title: CTE Next Fest Update!
events.summary: Since Call The Exterminator has Opted in for Steam Next Fest, we have decided to release a update that overhauls the in-game gore system!- Gibbing an enemy will now splatter blood on Walls, Floors, and Ceilings!- Eyeballs added to the list of gibs- Blood splatters that hit the ceiling have a chance to drip blood!- Blood splatters that hit the ceiling have a chance to spawn meaty chunks that slowly separate from the ceiling and splat on the floor!What else am I working on?- Shared ammo for weapon

events.title: CTE Update!
